messages:
Alex: Quick sync — plan to roll out `nudge_targeting` flag (cohort-hash routing) to 5% starting T+1h. Need two things before flip: (1) console preview to show cohort assignment + sampled responses, (2) telemetry + alerts for quality regressions and cost. Ping @Mira @Diego for ops/telemetry. :eyes:

Mira: For telemetry, request: per-cohort 95p latency, token-cost per request, failure-rate, and a lightweight 'semantic-drift' metric (embedding-distance). Also capture a 0.1% sample of prompt/response diffs with trace-id for manual inspection.

Diego: Agree. Also want an auto-pause rule: if cohort error-rate rises by >0.5% absolute OR avg embedding-distance >0.2 vs baseline over a 10m window, pause rollout. We should support a dry-run (shadow) mode so metrics surface without changing routing.

Alex: We have a dry-run backend but console UX is poor. Proposal: add a "Shadow traffic" toggle on the rollout page + a preview table that shows cohort assignments and sample traces. Auto-pause should trigger the runbook and create a ticket, not auto-rollback. Ops can decide rollback.

Mira: Ops prefers auto-pause + pager at the first trigger, manual rollback on escalation. Suggested runbook snippet: `if alert == nudge_regression then run redwoodctl config pause --flag nudge_targeting --reason="auto-pause:regression"`

Diego: Can we standardize a rollback command in runbook too? e.g. `redwoodctl config rollback --flag nudge_targeting --to=stable --reason='regression'` and ensure each rollback writes an audit event with snapshot id + diff. Console should show snapshot diff before applying.

Sam: Also watch quota/cost — variant-B for this flag disables batching so per-token cost may increase. Add a quota alert if estimated monthly customer cost delta > $2000 or if per-minute spend > baseline + 30%.

Mira: Telemetry alert example (PromQL-like):
```
# percent increase in error-rate vs baseline over 10m
(delta(requests_errors_total{cohort="nudge_b"}[10m]) / delta(requests_total{cohort="nudge_b"}[10m]) - baseline_error_rate) > 0.005
```
and embedding drift check (pseudo):
```
avg_over_time(embedding_distance_vs_baseline{cohort="nudge_b"}[10m]) > 0.2
```
Both should fire the `nudge_regression` alert.

deploy-bot: Created rollout job id r-1764457890 (dry-run mode) for `nudge_targeting` to cohorts hash range [0..5%).

Alex: Action items: I'll open console PR for shadow toggle + preview table. Mira will draft alert rules + runbook text. Diego will implement auto-pause logic and ensure rollback CLI + audit events exist. Sam will add quota/cost alerts. Meeting at 10 to review playbook and mockups. :+1:
